title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jermaine Terry II works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Jermaine Terry II for a workout.
items.impact: Terry was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He signed with the Giants as an undrafted free agent last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' McKitty works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Tre' McKitty for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: McKitty spent the spring in the UFL. He was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Frazier works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Brandon Frazier for a workout.
items.impact: Frazier was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He will compete for a spot in training camp with the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Davidson works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Zach Davidson for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: Davidson was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He has appeared in three games in his career.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baylor Cupp works out for Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins hosted TE Baylor Cupp for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: Cupp was one of five tight ends to workout for Miami. He has appeared in one career game in the NFL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Cooper Jr. works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted DB Ryan Cooper Jr. for a workout.
items.impact: Cooper spent the spring in the UFL. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Folorunso Fatukasi works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted DT Folorunso Fatukasi for a workout.
items.impact: Fatukasi was placed on injured reserve due to a shoulder injury with the Texans last season. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Kendall works out for Lions
items.desc: The Lions hosted CB Anthony Kendall for a workout.
items.impact: Kendall spent last season with the Browns. He'll compete for a spot in training camp with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo suffers apparent injury during practice Friday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo left practice early on Friday.
items.impact: Skattebo went down after a collision with LB Arvell Reese. He remained on the sideline, but didn't return to practice. The Giants will be cautious with him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price not seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Jadarian Price was not seen practicing on Friday at Seahawks training camp.
items.impact: It is unclear as of now what Price is dealing with. The rookie has recently started to see more reps with the first-team offense in camp. There will be more updates provided on his status when available.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Peter Skoronski agrees to four-year extension with Titans
items.desc: Peter Skoronski has agreed to a four-year, $100 million contract extension with the Tennessee Titans according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Skoronski's extension includes $88 million in guarantees while also making the former first-round pick the highest paid guard in the NFL as a key protector of quarterback Cam Ward and a developing Tennessee offense under new head coach Robert Saleh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. leaves practice early Friday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. left Friday's practice early.
items.impact: Mims pulled up as he was running after a deep ball from Bo Nix. He was talking with trainers before leaving practice. There will be an update provided when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Trey Smith is not practicing on Friday due to a hip injury.
items.impact: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said he's not worried about Smith's availability. He should return to practice this weekend or early next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Xavier Worthy is still not practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Worthy remains absent from practice due to a shoulder injury. It is unclear how much longer he will be sidelined for.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) unlikely to play in preseason
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes II is unlikely to play in the preseason.
items.impact: Mahomes continues to make progress early on during training camp. He remains hopeful to be good to go for the start of the season, but his status will need to be monitored.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Henningsen carted off field from practice Friday
items.desc: Broncos Matt Henningsen was carted off the field during practice on Friday.
items.impact: Henningsen will be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status when available. Palmer notes he was "in a lot of pain" as he was carted off.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (personal) not practicing Friday, expected back Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell is not practicing on Friday due to personal reasons.
items.impact: It is an excused absence for Gainwell, who is expected to be back on Sunday. He is competing for a complimentary role alongside Bucky Irving.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Echols (ankle) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Brandin Echols is not practicing on Friday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Echols signed a two-year contract with Pittsburgh back in March.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) still not practicing Friday
items.desc: Makai Lemon remained absent from practice at Eagles training camp on Friday.
items.impact: Lemon has been sidelined from practice this week due to a hamstring injury. It is not ideal for the rookie to be missing practice time, but we're still over a month away till the start of the season. His status will need to continue to be monitored.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) remains absent from practice Friday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Smith has remained sidelined this week due to a hamstring injury. It is unclear how long he'll be sidelined for.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner McKee works with second-team in practice Friday
items.desc: Tanner McKee worked with the Eagles second-team unit in practice on Friday.
items.impact: McKee continues to rotate with Andy Dalton as they compete for the backup job behind Jalen Hurts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brevin Jordan not practicing Friday due to minor injury
items.desc: Brevin Jordan is not practicing at Texans training camp as a precautionary measure.
items.impact: Jordan is dealing with a minor injury and won't miss much time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Max Iheanachor (undisclosed) expected to return to practice Monday
items.desc: Max Iheanachor is expected to return to practice at Steelers training camp on Monday.
items.impact: Iheanachor left Thursday's practice with an undisclosed injury. He was the first-round pick for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carlton Davis III (hamstring) to be sidelined through end of week
items.desc: Carlton Davis III is expected to be sidelined from practice through the end of the week.
items.impact: Davis is battling through a hamstring injury. He'll look to return to practice next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Jurgens leaves practice early Friday
items.desc: Cam Jurgens left Friday's practice early with an apparent injury.
items.impact: Jurgens spent time in the medical tent before he headed inside the facility with trainers. There should be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nik Bonitto (leg) practicing Friday
items.desc: Nik Bonitto is in full pads at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Bonitto was sidelined from practice earlier this week due to a leg injury. He is back in full pads on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Wattenberg not practicing Friday
items.desc: Broncos OL Luke Wattenberg is not practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Wattenberg is sitting out of practice for a fourth straight day. He's still with the team observing at practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Courtland Sutton in full pads at practice Friday
items.desc: Courtland Sutton was seen in full pads to begin practice on Friday.
items.impact: It is a positive sign after Sutton missed practice on Tuesday and Wednesday before he was limited in his return on Thursday. It appears he should be able to do more in practice on Friday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cyrus Allen (shin) back at practice on Friday
items.desc: Cyrus Allen (shin) is back at practice on Friday, nearly a week after he suffered a bruised shin.
items.impact: Allen was the talk of Chiefs training camp this offseason, and now the team gets him back. He will look to crack the lineup and make some noise come go time, but for now he's just a late round dart in deep leagues at best.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylin Noel activated off of NFI list
items.desc: Jaylin Noel has been activated off of the Texans NFI list.
items.impact: The young receiver has missed camp so far due to an undisclosed injury, opening the door for Jayden Higgins and Tank Dell to see additional work over him. However, he should work himself into the rotation, muddying things up for fantasy for the time being until we get further clarity on the pecking order.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Alvin Kamara taking passing down reps in team drills
items.desc: Alvin Kamara had been taking the majority of the passing down reps for the Saints in team drills, with Travis Etienne taking the early down work.
items.impact: Pass catching has always been Kamara's specialty, and it seems Etienne's arrival hasn't changed much. How much work Kamara receives when things matter is up in the air, however. But for now, he is a decent dart throw in drafts, especially PPR formats.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) without timetable to return
items.desc: Alec Pierce is without a timetable to return, per HC Shane Steichen. However, he noted on both Wednesday and Thursday that Pierce's rehab process is going well, and that the receiver is putting in the work.
items.impact: It's not great news for the veteran wideout, as players who miss most of camp generally struggle to start the season and could be limiters for your fantasy roster. However, there's still time for things to change. In the meantime, Josh Downs and Ashton Dulin look like the primary beneficiaries of his absence, with Tyler Warren also factoring in.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Okuayinonu (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers DL Sam Okuayinonu returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okuayinonu left practice early on Wednesday due to an ankle injury. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Osa Odighizuwa returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers DE Osa Odighizuwa returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Odighizuwa sat out practice on Wednesday due to soreness. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Greenlaw sat out practice on Wednesday due to soreness. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Franklin-Myers dealing with back injury
items.desc: John Franklin-Myers back stiffness flared up in practice earlier this week.
items.impact: Franklin-Myers is day-to-day in Titans training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton Dowell waived by the 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers waived WR Colton Dowell.
items.impact: Dowell will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kion Smith signs with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers signed OT Kion Smith.
items.impact: Smith spent last season with the Dolphins. He'll compete for a depth role on the 49ers offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles placed on IR
items.desc: The Bills placed LB Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles on injured reserve.
items.impact: Flannigan-Fowles will likely miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Kattus activated from NFI list
items.desc: The Bengals activated TE Josh Kattus from the non-football illness list.
items.impact: Kattus has been cleared to return to practice. He signed with the Bengals after going undrafted in April.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ahmari Harvey released by Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers released Ahmari Harvey.
items.impact: Harvey will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Israel Mukuamu signs with Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers signed CB Israel Mukuamu.
items.impact: Mukuamu spent the spring in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shad Banks Jr. waived by Titans
items.desc: The Titans waived/injured LB Shad Banks.
items.impact: Banks will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dominique Hampton signs with Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed LB Dominique Hampton.
items.impact: Hampton spent last season on the Bears practice squad. He will compete for a depth role in the Titans linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saahdiq Charles released by Panthers with injury settlement
items.desc: The Panthers released OG Saahdiq Charles with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Charles had originally been placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ainias Smith waived by Panthers with injury settlement
items.desc: The Panthers waived WR Ainias Smith with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Smith spent all of last season on the Panthers practice squad. He will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Guyton (elbow) practices Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Guyton practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Guyton was limited in practice earlier this week due to an elbow injury. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (leg) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Overshown was sidelined from practice on Wednesday due to a leg injury. It didn't appear to be a serious concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean McKeon (shoulder) placed on IR
items.desc: The Colts placed TE Sean McKeon on injured reserve.
items.impact: McKeon will likely miss the upcoming season on injured reserve. The Colts signed Pharaoh Brown as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pharaoh Brown signs with Colts
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Pharaoh Brown.
items.impact: Brown appeared in seven games with the Cardinals last season. He'll complete for a depth role in the Colts tight end room.
